angle: The use case that moved people had nothing to do with productivity
hook: The best AI use case this year made people cry
caption:
Every AI post is about speed and output. Then someone used it to restore old footage of a grandparent for a wedding, played it in the room, and the whole thing landed differently. Worth remembering that the tools everyone is using to write faster emails can do this too.

💬 Comment "RESTORE" and I'll send you the full list.
🔖 Save this for the next time you need it.
➡️ Follow @profit_prompts_ for the AI stack that actually pays.

#aivideo #family #memories #aitools #creativity #storytelling

slides.text: The best AI use case this year made people *cry*
We spend all day using these tools to save eleven minutes. Then someone does this with the same model.

slides.title: Start with what you have
slides.body: Old photographs, a shaky camcorder transfer, a voice note nobody deleted. The worse the source, the more obvious the restoration looks when you play it back.

slides.title: Upscale before anything else
slides.body: Run the footage through restoration first and judge it before you add music or cuts. Most of the emotional effect comes from simply seeing a face clearly again.

slides.left_text: Write this email faster. Summarise this document. Save me ten minutes.
slides.right_text: Make my grandmother's face clear again so the room can see her.

slides.title: Do it before you need it
slides.body: The families who have this are the ones who digitised the box of tapes on an ordinary weekend. Nobody ever regrets having done it early.

slides.text: Save this before you need it
slides.subline: Send it to someone still paying for this
